lines.t: If you bought ten Powerball tickets every single week… how long until you win the jackpot?
lines.title: HOW LONG TO *WIN?*

lines.t: The odds of winning the Powerball jackpot are one in two hundred ninety-two million.
lines.label: Powerball jackpot odds
lines.title: TICKETS

lines.t: Ten tickets a week is five hundred twenty tickets a year.
lines.title: 520 TICKETS *A YEAR*

lines.t: On average, you'd need about five hundred sixty thousand years to hit it once.
lines.label: Average wait at 10 tickets / week
lines.title: TO WIN *ONCE*

lines.t: That's longer than humans have existed. The lottery isn't a plan. It's entertainment… with a price tag.
lines.title: NOT A *PLAN*
lines.sub: It's entertainment with a price tag

lines.t: Follow for more money math they don't tell you.
lines.title: PLAY *SMART*
